  issue: if the probe names in `PROBE_TEST_SELECTION = "concurrent_prs or union_backstop"` (line 34) drift from test names in `tests/test_assemble_changelog.py`, pytest exits with code 5 ("no tests collected") and the failure message does not distinguish probe-name drift from a real conftest regression.
